svg.text: Stage 2 deployment in the AWS Academy Sandbox (us-east-1), created by one CloudFormation template
scripts/nimbus-stack.yaml creates every resource below. EC2 user data installs Nimbus,
checks RDS, starts the service, then cfn-signal → CREATE_COMPLETE only when the app is healthy.
route: local only · no internet, no NAT
Status: Stages 1–2 (VPC, EC2, RDS) deployed and verified 25 Oct 2026 · Stage 3 (scaling) after Week 9
No NAT gateway: the database needs no internet access. Passwords are CloudFormation NoEcho parameters, never stored in the repository.
